title: 第516章 被选择第515章 腰杆子都直了
content_zh:
第516章被选择
陈楚看马小翠笨手笨脚的，急得都出汗了。而且她面色红润，血气上涌，很显然就是酒精起作用了。
这个女人现在也越来越没劲，如果再让她这么折腾下去也不成事不说，酒劲上来可能她就睡着了，这一下啥也干不了了。
所以陈楚也就不装醉了，翻身一下狠狠地亲吻住马小翠的嘴唇。
因为此时陈楚发现，马小翠对自己的好感增加了100%。为啥增加到100%呢？陈楚开始费解，后来就释然了。
第一是她的丈夫赵三每天都打她，她承受着太多的家暴，对丈夫已经恨之入骨。
现在丈夫让她跟陈楚生个孩子，而陈楚可比她丈夫身高长相强太多倍了，再加上很平易近人。这样一对比，一堆屎和一堆肉的比较，马小翠在正反两方面自然100%选择陈楚。
而且她丈夫还不行。马小翠已经是一个26岁的女人了，她也是有权利需求的。
这一下更加触动了她最原始的雌性那种感应。
陈楚亲吻住她的嘴唇，让马小翠瞬间迷失，这种感觉才是真正的男人的感觉。
随后陈楚和她开始舌吻，马小翠更是一动不动。几下子马小翠便不挂一丝，陈楚也开始……
而且马小翠大声叫了起来。
……
小麦色的美背渗透出了无数细密的汗珠，一个小时后还没有停止。而陈楚更加的卖力，又过了一个小时。
两个小时并不是陈楚的极限，而只是对方的承受能力。此时，陈楚已经百分之百吸收了对方的至阴之气。
这次没想到会这样的容易，也源于马小翠这人太过纯质。在她生命里只有两个男人，一个是她丈夫，另外一个是陈楚。
或者说，在她生命里只有一个男人，那就是陈楚。因为她丈夫不行，竟然还是处子之身，陈楚也不理解。
此时，在自己的小世界内发生了翻天覆地的变化。1350范围的小世界开始持续增长，1360、1400平方公里、1500，最后达到了1700平方公里才真正的停止了。
而陈楚的精神力量，也扩张到了1700平方公里。陈楚呼出了一口浊气。
此时，意识内的罗刹女也惊呼了一声：“好强的力量，好强的力道啊！陈楚，你这又挖到什么宝了？”

随后，罗刹女的意识进入陈楚的意识当中，了解了这段经历，不禁唏嘘道：“像马小翠这样的女人的确太难寻找了，而且还能百分之百的被你吸收，可能只有这一次了。因为你小子把好运都占尽了。”
陈楚意识回答道：“罗刹女殿下，我越强大，你恢复真正实力的时候也就越来越近了。”
“哼！”罗刹女冷冷一哼，“本大王曾经的实力是你无法想象的。单凭一个马小翠还差得远呢，你小子以后再多多努力吧。”
罗刹女说完，便不再多说。
意念随之一动，随后又销声匿迹，不知道隐藏在小世界的哪一方天地去了。
陈楚又打坐呼吸了几次，才睁开眼，随后手轻轻地按在马小翠的穴位上，一股真气进入了她的身体。
刚才的马小翠几乎奄奄一息，在得到真气之后才慢慢的缓和了过来，随后浑身感觉充满了力量，脸蛋也出现了一抹的红润。
而他不知道的是和陈楚进行之后，本来她只是一个平凡的女子，而现在也得到了陈楚的不少的真气。已经进入了修行阶段的门槛了。
她连忙起身穿好了衣服，脸上娇羞不止。
陈楚笑了笑：“赵三还在外面吧，我先回去了。”
马小翠连忙道：“别的啊，你从后门走。”
马小翠连忙打开了后门，陈楚笑了笑，从后门离开。
而在外面一直站大岗的赵三听见里面没了声音，便推门进了房间，看着媳妇已经把衣服穿好。
这才问：“干完了？”
马小翠点了点头。
content_en:
Chapter 516 Chosen
Chen Chu was so anxious that he was sweating when he saw Ma Xiaocui's clumsiness. Moreover, her face was rosy and her blood was rising. It was obvious that the alcohol had played a role.
This woman is getting more and more bored now. If she continues to toss like this, nothing will happen. She may fall asleep when she is drunk, and she won't be able to do anything now.
So Chen Chu stopped pretending to be drunk, turned over and kissed Ma Xiaocui hard on the lips.
Because at this time, Chen Chu discovered that Ma Xiaocui's favorable impression of him had increased by 100%. Why increase it to 100%? Chen Chu was confused at first, but then he felt relieved.
The first is that her husband Zhao San beats her every day. She has endured too much domestic violence and hates her husband to the core.
Now her husband wants her to have a child with Chen Chu, and Chen Chu is many times stronger than her husband in height and appearance, and he is also very approachable. In such a comparison, between a pile of shit and a pile of meat, Ma Xiaocui naturally chooses Chen Chu 100% in terms of pros and cons.
And her husband is not good enough. Ma Xiaocui is already a 26-year-old woman, and she also has rights and demands.
This touched her most primitive female instincts even more.
Chen Chu kissed her lips, making Ma Xiaocui instantly lost. This feeling is what a real man feels like.
Then Chen Chu and her began to kiss each other, and Ma Xiaocui remained motionless. After a while, Ma Xiaocui stopped showing off, and Chen Chu also started...
And Ma Xiaocui shouted loudly.
…
Countless beads of sweat seeped out of her beautiful wheat-colored back, and they didn't stop even after an hour. And Chen Chu worked even harder, and another hour passed.
Two hours is not Chen Chu's limit, but only the opponent's ability to bear it. At this time, Chen Chu had absorbed 100% of the opponent's Yin energy.
I didn't expect it to be so easy this time, and it was also because Ma Xiaocui was too pure. There are only two men in her life, one is her husband and the other is Chen Chu.
In other words, there is only one man in her life, and that is Chen Chu. Because her husband is not good enough, he is still a virgin, and Chen Chu doesn't understand.
At this time, earth-shaking changes took place in my own little world. The small world within the scope of 1350 began to grow continuously, 1360, 1400 square kilometers, 1500, and finally reached 1700 square kilometers before it really stopped.
And Chen Chu's spiritual power also expanded to 1,700 square kilometers. Chen Chu exhaled a thick breath.
At this time, the Rakshasa girl in her consciousness also exclaimed: "What a powerful force, what a powerful force! Chen Chu, what kind of treasure have you dug up now?"
Later, the consciousness of the Rakshasa girl entered Chen Chu's consciousness, and after understanding this experience, she couldn't help but lamented: "It is really difficult to find a woman like Ma Xiaocui, and she can be 100% absorbed by you. This may be the only time. Because you have taken all the good luck."
Chen Chu replied consciously: "Your Highness, the female Rakshasa, the stronger I am, the closer it will be for you to regain your true strength."
"Hmph!" the Rakshasa woman snorted coldly, "The strength of this great king was beyond your imagination. Ma Xiaocui alone is still far behind. You should work harder in the future."
After the Rakshasa girl finished speaking, she said no more.
The thought moved, and then disappeared. I don't know where in the small world it was hidden.
Chen Chu meditated and breathed a few more times before opening his eyes. Then he gently pressed his hand on Ma Xiaocui's acupuncture point, and a burst of true energy entered her body.
Ma Xiaocui was almost dying just now. After gaining the energy, she slowly recovered. Then her whole body felt full of strength, and her face became rosy.
What he didn't know was that after interacting with Chen Chu, she was originally just an ordinary woman, but now she also gained a lot of Qi from Chen Chu. We have entered the threshold of the cultivation stage.
She evenHe got up and got dressed hurriedly, his face full of embarrassment.
Chen Chu smiled: "Zhao San is still outside, I'll go back first."
Ma Xiaocui said quickly: "Otherwise, you go through the back door."
Ma Xiaocui quickly opened the back door. Chen Chu smiled and left through the back door.
Zhao San, who had been standing guard outside, heard that there was no sound inside, so he opened the door and entered the room, seeing that his wife had already put on her clothes.
Then he asked: "Are you done?"
Ma Xiaocui nodded.
